🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector performance (Materials/Energy/Staples/Healthcare/Cons Disc positive vs Tech/Financials/Industrials negative) and broad leadership across sectors; however a MAJOR divergence among large-cap names argues for neutrality. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND; Energy strong: SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +14.24%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples/Healthcare showing steady bid: PG (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Real Estate weak; Financials lagging: MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND and COF (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -11.94%) BELOW TREND. Industrials showing pockets of weakness: GE (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -6.52%) BELOW TREND and MMM (1W: -4.92% | 1M: +1.67%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.11% | 1M: -0.41%) RECOVERY, SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BK (1W: -4.71% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION, MMM (1W: -4.92% | 1M: +1.67%) CORRECTION, GS (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +2.21%) CORRECTION, MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials and parts of Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.11% | 1M: -0.41%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (MSFT, GOOGL, META, INTC, TSLA showing 1W vs 1M mismatches) — watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to mildly negative despite pockets of strength: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND, but ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND and AVGO (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND. Sector note: Technology underperformed this week; overall market breadth remains mixed (5/11 positive).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are weak on the week with notable dispersion: GS (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +2.21%) CORRECTION and MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND, while select names have positive news flow. Style: mixed / no clear leadership between Growth and Value as Financials lag but cyclicals elsewhere lead.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive: GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND, but ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND is a clear outlier. Sector note: Healthcare one of the positive sectors this week within a mixed market.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Materials and Energy leaders (NEM, SLB) and selective Healthcare (GILD, UNH); reduce exposure to weak Financials and underperforming Tech (MS, ORCL). Given the MAJOR divergence among large caps, position sizing should be cautious and monitoring of trend-confirmation signals is advised.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through required. BEARISH: ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND, MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials and Energy (sector returns positive and top performers concentrated there). BEARISH: Financials and Real Estate (weak week and several names showing CORRECTION/BENEATH TREND).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch for continuation signals rather than exact price targets: AMD sustaining above this week’s highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; NVDA holding recent gains to keep ABOVE TREND status; AAPL reclaiming short-term losses to begin shifting from BELOW TREND; UNH remaining above its 1M pace to confirm further upside.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+55): Nvidia invests in CoreWeave — NVDA (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND — news largely confirming price action. SLB (+50): Beats earnings — SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirms accumulation. NEM (+50): Gold rally headline — NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned. ORCL (+50): AI backlog headline — ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND — news positive but price diverging.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ABT (-55): Q4 miss and softer guidance — ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. INTC (-50): Earnings-led selloff — INTC (1W: -6.73% | 1M: +23.92%) CORRECTION — negative sentiment aligns with short-term weakness. TMUS (-50): PT cuts — TMUS (1W: not provided | 1M: not provided) noted as negative in news flow; monitor price action for confirmation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among large caps (MSFT, GOOGL, META, INTC, TSLA mismatches) and notable bearish hits in ABT and select Financials — monitor for trend confirmation.
